lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately three horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank. The uppermost row contains the largest and most distinct centroids, while the middle row displays spots with slightly reduced pixel intensity and diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectilinear grid where the circular blobs act as the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced low-intensity gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is clearly visible attached to the lower lateral region of the whale shark, posterior to the gill area.
